svg.aria-label: Addition Agent2 and Math Agent2 instructions with handwritten notes. In Addition Agent2, always reply with a JSON report and nothing else: the reply arrives as one text string inside agent_response. findings holds the answer for the Math Agent to deliver, and openQuestions empty means nothing is left to ask. When a value is missing, findings is empty and openQuestions replaces the Part 1 prompt and absorbs the missing list. A follow-up rule replies Nothing more to add. In Math Agent2, read openQuestions first, ask the user the question in openQuestions and nothing else, then send the complete list again with the value filled in on the same conversation ID, and do not call the specialist for a thanks.
svg.text: The report format and who reads it, line by line
